policy.platform: two NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs per run.
policy.forbidden: the MLPerf Inference results repositories (mlcommons/inference_results_*), published MLPerf submissions, or the MLCommons results tables

tasks.task_prompt: Run `python -u main.py --scenario Offline --accuracy` at the README precision over the 24,576-sample OpenOrca validation set in DATASET_FILE, then evaluate-accuracy.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.torch cuda:: the value of `torch.cuda.is_available()` and the GPU names, written by the process that runs the model

hints: Any route the benchmark's own main.py supports is valid.
